# Pukako Panini & Coffee

> Pukako Panini & Coffee is a café in Ubud, Bali, Indonesia. Its main location, PUKAKO by Paddyfield, sits on the edge of the Subak Sok Wayah rice fields, a few hundred metres north of Jl. Raya Ubud, reachable only on foot or by scooter. It serves pressed panini all day, breakfast from 7am, smoothie bowls and specialty coffee. A second café, Pukako Bisma, is on Jalan Bisma, Ubud. Facts last checked 2026-11-15.

## Key facts
- Name: Pukako Panini & Coffee (PUKAKO by Paddyfield)
- Type: Café: panini, breakfast & brunch, smoothie bowls, specialty coffee
- Where: Subak Sok Wayah rice fields, Ubud, Bali · second café on Jalan Bisma
- Hours: Every day, 7am to 9pm
- Prices: Breakfast Specials 59K IDR until 3pm · panini 64K–79K · coffee from 28K
- Known for: Rice field view, Ubud Panini, V60, smoothie bowls
- Ratings: 4.6★ Google (823 reviews) · 4.6 Tripadvisor (47), 5.0 atmosphere
- Access: Footpath, on foot or by scooter; no car access
- Address (main): Jl. Raya Uma, Jl. Subak Sok Wayah, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia. Coordinates -8.5024638, 115.2571934.
- WhatsApp: Sok Wayah +62 813-3862-9990 · Bisma +62 821-4425-7229
- Motto: "Panini all day, coffee anytime, we serve you everywhere."
- Payment: Visa and Mastercard with no surcharge; American Express +3.5%. Menu prices exclude 6% service and 10% tax.

## Menu highlights (IDR)
- Breakfast Specials 59,000 each until 3pm daily: Avocado Ham Toast, Cheese Omelette, Pesto Avocado Toast, Combo Pukako, Healing Bowl, Fluffy Pancake, French Toast, Chia Dragon Smoothie
- Ubud Panini 79,000 (grilled chicken, pesto, avocado, tomato, bacon, mozzarella; with sweet potato fries)
- Pukako Panini 79,000 (homemade grilled beef patty, sautéed mushroom, pickled cucumber, mozzarella)
- Other panini 64,000–78,000; Vegan Falafel 79,000; Roasted Pumpkin 73,000
- Coffee: espresso 28,000 · latte/cappuccino 36,000 · V60 (Aceh Gayo & Kintamani Natural) 35,000 · Pukako Ice Coffee 49,000
- Smoothie bowls 65,000–79,000 · Sawah Green juice 55,000

## Frequently asked questions
### What is Pukako Panini & Coffee?
Pukako Panini & Coffee is a café in Ubud, Bali, serving pressed panini, breakfast, smoothie bowls and specialty coffee. It has two locations: PUKAKO by Paddyfield, on the edge of the Subak Sok Wayah rice fields, and Pukako Bisma, on Jalan Bisma in Ubud.

### Where is Pukako by Paddyfield and how do I get there?
It is at Jl. Raya Uma, Jl. Subak Sok Wayah, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571, a few hundred metres north of Jl. Raya Ubud. The café is reached by a small footpath through the rice fields, on foot or by scooter only; cars cannot get there.

### What are the opening hours?
PUKAKO by Paddyfield is open every day from 7am to 9pm, according to its Google Maps listing.

### How much does it cost to eat at Pukako?
Breakfast Specials cost 59K IDR each until 3pm every day. Panini cost 64K to 79K IDR, coffee starts at 28K IDR for an espresso and a V60 pour-over is 35K IDR. Menu prices exclude 6% service and 10% tax.

### What should I order at Pukako?
The signatures are the Ubud Panini (grilled chicken, pesto, avocado, tomato, bacon and mozzarella, 79K IDR) and the Pukako Panini (homemade beef patty, 79K IDR), a V60 of Aceh Gayo or Kintamani Natural coffee (35K IDR), and the Pukako smoothie bowl (65K IDR). In Google reviews, 42 mention the panini and 40 mention the smoothie bowls.

### Does Pukako have vegetarian or vegan food?
Yes. The menu includes a Vegan Falafel plate, Vegetable Panini, Mushroom Spinach Panini, Roasted Pumpkin and smoothie bowls, and Tripadvisor lists the café as suitable for vegetarians with vegan options.

### Can I work on a laptop at Pukako?
Yes. Guests regularly mention working there in Google reviews, including good Wi-Fi, and the café opens at 7am. Visa and Mastercard are accepted without a surcharge.

### Which payment methods are accepted?
Pukako accepts Visa and Mastercard with no surcharge; American Express carries a 3.5% surcharge, according to the menu.

### Does Pukako deliver?
Yes. Pukako takes delivery orders through GoFood and GrabFood, and each location can be contacted on WhatsApp: +62 813-3862-9990 for Sok Wayah and +62 821-4425-7229 for Bisma.

### What does the name PUKAKO mean?
In Bali the first child is often named Putu, the second Kadek and the third Komang. PUKAKO joins the first syllables of those names, and the founder's family has three brothers. The café comes from the same family as Semujaen Restaurant.

### How is Pukako rated?
PUKAKO by Paddyfield has 4.6 out of 5 from 823 Google reviews, 173 of which mention the rice field view, and 4.6 out of 5 from 47 Tripadvisor reviews with 5.0 for atmosphere. The Dutch travel site Barts Boekje called it "our favorite breakfast spot in Ubud" in June 2024.
